text:
anya: just pushed v3.2-quant4 to staging. quick sanity: overall throughput good but longdoc MRR down ~1.8% vs prod-v3.1. also rerank precision dropped for 'search' slice. starting canary now — watch for gating suggestions

sam: can you paste the smoke numbers?

anya: sure — smoke summary:
```
baseline: prod v3.1
staging: v3.2-quant4
metrics:
  longdoc_MRR: 0.243 -> 0.238 (delta -1.8%)
  rerank_precision@10: 0.412 -> 0.399 (delta -3.2%)
  latency_p95: 120ms -> 130ms
```

peter: if MRR delta > 2% we auto rollback. this is borderline at -1.8%. what's the CI/variance on the rerank number?

eva: suggest a 24h A/B with 5% traffic on the search-longdocs slice, plus concordance and rerank-precision monitoring. rule: if any primary metric exits 95% CI -> fallback.

anya: @sam ran a quick CI bootstrap — rerank p≈0.04, MRR p≈0.12 for the smoke batch. smoke id: smk-20260323-11

ci-bot: smoke smk-20260323-11 finished: rerank_precision delta -3.2% (p=0.038), longdoc_MRR delta -1.9% (p=0.12)

sam: -3.2% rerank is statistically significant. do not promote. proposed immediate fallback thresholds: rerank_precision delta <= -2% OR longdoc_MRR delta <= -2.5% -> rollback. else slow ramp with watch.

peter: also add a "quiet-burn" watch: 48h at 1% traffic, auto-fail if a rolling mean breaches thresholds for 30m. helps catch slow drift.

eva: can we put route-level routing so rerank-heavy routes keep v3.1? example config snippet:
```json
{ "route": "search.rerank", "preferred": "v3.1", "fallback": "v3.2-quant4" }
```

anya: I'll update rollout policy and create a canary: 1% quiet-burn + 5% AB on search-longdocs. tagging @sam @peter for approval.

sam: approved. @ops-bot schedule canary for 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

ops-bot: scheduled canary 2026-03-24T09:00Z for smk-20260323-11. notifications will be sent to #eng-ml and #release-war-room.

peter: one more — add structured logs for top-3 rerank candidates + user click concordance for first 10k samples so we can do offline analysis quickly.

anya: noted. will push rollout config & monitoring dashboard before the run. thanks everyone.
